examples.description: Count overdue days in Kuala Lumpur time, resending every defaulted field as sales_settings_read returned it so none resets

Match an invoice the business already uses: read its image yourself (Simpler reads no images), then send template_style (clean: mostly black and white; professional: a dark or muted brand colour; modern: a bright colour or three or more colours) and its two main colours as #rrggbb, resending every defaulted field. Documents print a colour that is not #rrggbb in the default instead
Make new invoices and quotes start with Singapore GST (a create that names its own tax_scheme, or "none", still wins), resending every defaulted field so none resets

failure_modes.recovery: Resend the same call with a value from the listed enum (for example timezone 'Asia/Kuala_Lumpur'); keep every other key as sent.
failure_modes.when: timezone is not one of the listed zones, default_currency is not a supported currency, tax_scheme is not sg_gst, my_sst or none, or default_tax_rate_bps is outside 0-10000 (an agent's call is checked when the owner-approved call runs)

failure_modes.recovery: The owner approves the pending action in the app; nothing changes until then.
failure_modes.when: an agent calls it: business settings print on every document

preconditions: Singleton per tenant: scope is always 'default'.

description: [REQUIRES APPROVAL] Saves your business identity and document defaults (one row per business; scope is 'default'). timezone is the business clock: an invoice turns overdue at midnight in that zone after its due day, and days_overdue counts days there; unset means Asia/Singapore. Left out, timezone and the text fields keep their saved value, but defaulted fields (default_currency, default_tax_rate_bps, payment_terms_days, invoice_prefix, quote_prefix, template_style) reset, so resend them from sales_settings_read. An agent call waits for the owner's approval. Refuses an unlisted timezone or currency, or a tax rate outside 0-10000, with VALIDATION_ERROR before it waits for approval: send a listed value.
name: sales_settings_upsert
